editor.saveContractAriaLabel: Auto backup and final save state
editor.diskContractNeedsSave: not on disk · click Save or press ⌘S
editor.validateContractClean: after saving, run folder check or folder validate
editor.validateContractDirty: before save: verification still reads disk
editor.revertContractClean: confirm before closing · git diff can recover
editor.previewTooltip: Render the result next to what you type
editor.saveConflict: This file changed on disk before the save completed. Your edits are kept. Copy them, refresh, then apply them to the latest file.
editor.saveIdentityUid: This line (uid) is the permanent id that keeps the document recognizable even after a rename, so it cannot be removed or changed. Restore the uid line and the save will go through.
editor.saveIdentityHistory: This line (merged_uids) records the documents merged into this one, so it cannot be edited here. Restore that line and the save will go through.
editor.discardConfirm: Discard unsaved changes and close the editor?
editor.mentionRelationFooter: Saved as a connection in the info block at the top, and a link goes into the text
editor.mentionEmpty: Nothing by that name in this folder
editor.mentionRelationAdded: Connected: it shows on the map

meta.notOnMapWikiBody: This is a write-up about sources, so it is not on the map. That is the design, not a gap. The map carries concepts; a page like this is read in the Library, beside the document it came from.
meta.recordTimeTitle: Last written {at}. That is when the file changed, which is not the same as when someone checked it.
meta.revisionTitle: {count, plural, one {# commit has} other {# commits have}} changed this document. Git keeps the count; nobody edits it.
